en: A black and white historical postcard depicting the impressive facade of a grand hotel with classical European architecture. The building is labeled 'Központi-szálloda' and 'Hotel-Central' on its roof and above the windows. There are several signs in Hungarian and German. In the foreground, there is a street scene with a horse-drawn carriage, tram, ornamental lamppost, and people walking or working. The postcard also features trees and cobblestone streets, suggesting an early 20th-century urban environment. The word 'Budapest' appears at the top, indicating the location.
